paras: At Amberstill Ranch in eastern Dun Morogh, Veron Amberstill tends the rams Ironforge riders trust.

Veron Amberstill breeds and trains mountain rams at Amberstill Ranch in eastern Dun Morogh. Their sure footing and thick coats suit the steep slopes and mountain blizzards of Khaz Modan. He raises them to carry dwarven scouts, mountaineers, and traveling adventurers. Veron offers standard and swift mounts to fellow dwarves. Riders from other peoples must prove loyalty to Ironforge's throne before he parts with a ram.
